source: Nigerian Exchange Group Plc interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, GROUP June 2026 year-to-date column, in thousands of naira; no cost of sales line is filed | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 Net Finance Costs written as 0 from Nigerian Exchange Group Plc interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib), Group year to date column: the finance cost line prints a dash in both 2026 columns, so the period carries no finance cost and no finance income line is printed. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit stay absent because the filing prints no cost of sales line.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: Nigerian Exchange Group five year financial summary, group, page 117, line Interest expense on borrowings (763,013), (2,314,816), (2,340,389) and (2,100,468) in thousands of naira for FY2025 to FY2022, with no borrowing cost printed for FY2021 so that cell stays empty. Multiplied by one thousand to the file's absolute scale, which the same summary confirms: it prints Revenue 22,980,686 and the file's Revenue row is 22,980,686,000.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Nigerian Exchange Group five year financial summary, group, page 117, line Profit before income tax expense: 15,550,526 / 13,609,507 / 5,288,961 / 823,089 / 2,394,221 in thousands of naira, multiplied by one thousand to the file's absolute scale. It ties every year: 15,550,526 less income tax 5,071,244 equals the printed profit for the year 10,479,282 which the file already carries, and 13,609,507 less 3,689,105 equals 9,920,402.

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47548_NIGERIAN_EXCHANGE_GROUP_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
